effective_size.note: the rejection rate of p < threshold on mean-0 nulls: ABC-weighted over the null-sides nearest the 2002-2009 d-series in its twelve centred summaries (matched), and the lowest and the worst matched and the worst battery null-side; a rejection is evidence at this size, not at a nominal 0.05. Nearest in those summaries is not alike in what drives size: the matched null-sides' sizes spread from the lowest to the worst

label: proxy: realised variance from daily closes stands in for the true variance (Patton 2011: QLIKE ranks forecasts correctly under it)
